description: Board approves second-charge credit risk appetite and strategy annually
Credit policy reviewed and re-endorsed by Risk Committee
New product approval requires credit risk sign-off before launch
Lending criteria held as versioned rules with provenance and change log
Single-borrower and LTV limits enforced in origination system
Delegated lending authority matrix; underwriter approval independent of sales
Policy exceptions signed off by credit risk and logged
Application scorecard used in affordability triage
Completion checklist: security perfected and documents filed
Internal risk grade assigned and refreshed on event
Monthly portfolio MI to Risk Committee incl. concentrations
Annual portfolio stress test of house price and rate shocks
Forbearance and problem-credit workout policy with fair treatment checks
Independent credit review samples completed loans quarterly
Limit breaches escalated to CRO within 2 working days
Internal audit of credit risk management on risk-based cycle
Independent validation of scorecard and rating models
